key_decisions: BOTH MODEL SLOTS ARE THE USER'S (Fabio, 2026-08-22): a Render model over all five SDXL ids and a Blend model over klein-9b/klein-4b, resolving independently. The recommendation is klein-9b, and it deliberately DISAGREES with the bake - the graph still loads 4B standing alone at the bench, and the 4B arm is what catches a re-export moving that default.

Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name is DOTTED while Input_Base_Model and Input_Edit_Model are plain. That asymmetry is load-bearing: ckpt_name and unet_name are on comfyController._inject's spray list and clip_name is NOT, so a plain key matches the node and silently writes nothing. Do not 'tidy' it.

The picker uses the new ungated sizeTierLetter(), NOT tierLetterFor(). The latter is install-gated by design, and this picker exists to choose BEFORE anything is installed, so the gate would blank the letter exactly when two rows both read 'FLUX.2 Klein'. One letter map still - tierLetterFor sits on top of it.

JUDGE THE SEAM WITH cnr, NEVER edge_step; judge the shadow with objsheet.py, NEVER shadow_ratio. An abs threshold ranks configs wrong in BOTH directions and crowned g192, which is actually the second-worst seam. DO NOT SHIP g192.

Seam visibility is SCENE-DEPENDENT and that is a product fact: the same DC offset is invisible in gravel (std 51.6) and glaring in smooth grass or sky (std 10.9 / 2.6). It will hit users on plain backgrounds and effectively never on textured ones. The box step's hint already says so.
constraints: GATE THE OUTPUT COMPARISON ON PIXELS, NEVER BYTES. ComfyUI bakes the dispatched prompt into a PNG tEXt chunk, so two files holding the same picture hash differently the moment node ids differ - which they do by construction here. The first live run reported DIFFERS on the sha alone and that read as a failure it was not.

RE-RUN graph_parity.py AFTER ANY EDIT TO THIS GRAPH. A positionally shifted widgets_values entry is silent: the converter shifts every later value and ComfyUI still validates. That check is the only thing that catches it.

AN OUT-OF-RANGE WIDGET IS NOT AN ERROR. mask_blend_pixels > 64 and GrowMaskWithBlur.blur_radius > 100 make ComfyUI prune the branch and still report success in ~0.2-2s with the sampler never run. Always assert your own SaveImage prefix produced a file.

HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by a guard hook that fires on `<<`. Write a .py file and run it by path. Windows python also needs sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8'), and json.load on a board file needs encoding='utf-8-sig'.

A MUTATION TEST MUST RESTORE IN `finally`, or the crash that kills it leaves a real repo file broken and the mutant reads as your own edit. Both mutation runs this session did, and both re-verified byte-for-byte afterwards.
